description: Hon. Attorney General v. Balawickrema Kankanamage Upul Chandana Balawickrema Hon. Attorney General v. Balawickrema Kankanamage Upul Chandana Balawickrema View More before Hon. L.U. Jayasuriya, J
parties: Hon. Attorney General v. Balawickrema Kankanamage Upul Chandana Balawickrema Hon. Attorney General v. Balawickrema Kankanamage Upul Chandana Balawickrema View More
keywords: Appeal by Attorney General seeking enhancement of sentence and fine – Theft/misappropriation of public property – Guilty plea – Public property valued at Rs.300,000 – High Court fine of Rs.50,000 challenged as inadequate – Statutory provision stating fine should be three times value of stolen property – Stolen chins spreader machine recovered undamaged – No loss caused to State – High Court retaining discretion as to quantum where property recovered intact – No basis to enhance sentence or fine – Judgment affirmed – Appeal dismissed. Deepali Wijesundera J. agreed.
legistation: Penal Code – section 336; Offences Against Public Property Act No. 12 of 1982, as amended – section 3; Judicature Act No. 2 of 1978 – section 15(b); Code of Criminal Procedure Act – sections 328(b)(ii) and 331.
